channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Shaquille O'Neal | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Shaquille O'Neal from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Ricky Rubio on Michael Jordan, Shaquille O'Neal, Stephen Curry, Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Ricky Rubio:

“Victor Wembanyama, one of the rare few capable of changing the NBA game, like Stephen Curry, Michael Jordan, or Shaquille O'Neal.”

Ricky Rubio on Michael Jordan, Shaquille O'Neal, Stephen Curry, Victor Wembanyama, May 28, 2026. Source: L'Equipe.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Kevin Durant, Michael Jordan, Shaquille O'Neal, Tim Duncan
item.description:
“Bron at the one, he getting everybody involved. At my two, I'm going, Michael Jordan. At my three, you know who I'm going, Kevin Durant. At my four, I'm coming, Tim Duncan. At my five, I'm coming, Shaquille O'Neal.”

Anthony Edwards on Kevin Durant, Michael Jordan, Shaquille O'Neal, Tim Duncan, Apr 30, 2025. Source: Fade Away World.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Shaquille O'Neal, Tom Brady
item.description:
“But I mean, I've seen some of my favorite athletes pivot and have tremendous success. When I think of Shaq[uille O'Neal] leaving the Lakers and winning a ring or Tom Brady winning one with Tampa Bay, it's been done before.”

Klay Thompson on Shaquille O'Neal, Tom Brady, Nov 12, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Dwight Howard on Shaquille O'Neal
item.description:
Dwight Howard on Shaquille O'Neal:

“He said some things to me that were personal, you know, messages to me that I ain't going to reveal in public. They were very disrespectful, but I ain’t... for real. Yeah, I ain't.(… ) But you ain't respond though, right? Dwight Howard:”

Dwight Howard on Shaquille O'Neal, Sep 28, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Dwight Howard on Shaquille O'Neal
item.description:
Dwight Howard on Shaquille O'Neal:

“It’s got to be like a one-sided beef because I ain’t never had no beef with this man. Maybe because when we were playing against each other, I was probably joking and laughing while doing some stuff, but not like that. I don’t know, maybe he wore the Superman logo better, that’s why he’s mad. But everybody can be whatever doggone character they want to be. I wasn’t trying to be Superman because of him or copycat something he was doing. People called me Superman because I jumped over my teammate in practice and was doing real-life Superman stuff. It wasn’t because I wanted to call myself Superman like him.”

Dwight Howard on Shaquille O'Neal, Sep 28, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Dwight Howard on Shaquille O'Neal
item.description:
Dwight Howard on Shaquille O'Neal:

“Why do I have to ask Shaq to wear a cape for a dunk contest? It’s not like Warner Brothers told me I couldn’t do it. He doesn’t own the damn cape. I’m just wearing it for the crowd, for the fans. That’s what I was doing. He’s not mad at me for wearing a Superman suit, right? Because I don’t need his permission. Imagine if I had to ask Michael Jordan for permission to wear his socks while playing a pickup game with my kids at home. That’s ridiculous.”

Dwight Howard on Shaquille O'Neal, Sep 28, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Michael Jordan, Shaquille O'Neal
item.description:
said Baron Davis to Scoop B Radio.

“Michael Jordan because he is the business AND the brand. Steve Young does a helluva job. I would also say Jose Bautista is another one and then Shaquille O’Neal. That would probably round it out.”

Magic Johnson on Michael Jordan, Shaquille O'Neal, Sep 19, 2024. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Shaquille O'Neal
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Kevin Durant on passing Shaquille O'Neal for 8th on the NBA's all-time scoring list:

“I'm just grateful to be in a category with some of the greats. I know what Shaq meant to the game of basketball, so to be up there with him is a major honor”

Kevin Durant on Shaquille O'Neal, Mar 21, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Gary Payton on Kobe Bryant, Shaquille O'Neal, Jason Kidd, Brian Shaw, Nate McMillan, Detlef Schrempf, Damon Stoudamire, Bonzi Wells, Hersey Hawkins
item.description:
Payton shared with Poole and Johnson.

“We used to go fishing when my mom was pregnant with my brother. Detlef [Schrempf], Hersey [Hawkins]. Those were all of [Gary Sr.’s] teammates. Nate McMillan, Damon Stoudamire– [Jason] Kidd is like family, too. [Brian] Shaw is family. Big [Shaquille O'Neal]. Rest in peace Kobe [Bryant]. Kobe was around back then. I can literally go on. Bonzie Wells.”

Gary Payton on Kobe Bryant, Shaquille O'Neal, Jason Kidd, Brian Shaw, Nate McMillan, Detlef Schrempf, Damon Stoudamire, Bonzi Wells, Hersey Hawkins, Dec 19, 2023. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Shaquille O'Neal
item.description:
“We’re all a big family. Ernie, Kenny and Shaquille are brothers to me, and I wouldn’t still be here if it wasn’t for them and all the amazing people who work on our show,”

Charles Barkley on Shaquille O'Neal, Oct 17, 2022. Source: Warner Bros. Discovery.

item.title: LeBron James on Kobe Bryant, Shaquille O'Neal, Jerry West, Magic Johnson
item.description:
James said.

“I’m going Magic [Johnson] at 1, Jerry West at the 2, Kobe [Bryant] at the 3, myself at the 4 and Shaq (Shaquille O’Neal) at the 5.”

LeBron James on Kobe Bryant, Shaquille O'Neal, Jerry West, Magic Johnson, Sep 28, 2022. Source: Lakers Daily.

item.title: Ben Simmons on Shaquille O'Neal
item.description:
“When I was dealing with everything going on, I actually messaged [Shaquille O'Neal], and he put it out, and I was like, alright,”

Ben Simmons on Shaquille O'Neal, Sep 22, 2022. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Grant Hill on Shaquille O'Neal
item.description:
Grant Hill:

“Shaquille O’Neal choked out Gordan Giricek before a game. He put him in a sleeper hold and the guy was knocked out, passed out on the locker room floor before the game. Definitely one of Shaq’s memorable — or not-so-memorable — moments from the year and a half that I played with him with the Phoenix Suns.”

Grant Hill on Shaquille O'Neal, Aug 30, 2018. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: LaVar Ball on LeBron James, Shaquille O'Neal, Wilt Chamberlain
item.description:
LaVar Ball:

“The best playing in the NBA right now? Come on man. I’m biased. The best in the game right now is LeBron James. LeBron James is the best on the fact he’s stronger than everybody. It’s whoever is the biggest and strongest at that time. Like Wilt Chamberlain, he was stronger and faster than everybody. Shaquille O’Neal, same thing.”

LaVar Ball on LeBron James, Shaquille O'Neal, Wilt Chamberlain, Aug 4, 2018. Source: Lonzo Wire.

item.title: Andy Elisburg on LeBron James, Dwyane Wade, Shaquille O'Neal, Alonzo Mourning
item.description:
“It was an incredible, magical time having Dwyane be a part of the Miami Heat. He's been such a huge part of the history here. He's the greatest player in the history of the franchise. Obviously, we've had lots of incredible players here who have had incredible seasons, including, obviously, LeBron, who won MVPs here. And Shaq [O'Neal]. And Zo [Alonzo Mourning].”

Andy Elisburg on LeBron James, Dwyane Wade, Shaquille O'Neal, Alonzo Mourning, Mar 27, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Amare Stoudemire on LeBron James, Dwyane Wade, Carmelo Anthony, Shaquille O'Neal, Allen Iverson, Steve Nash
item.description:
David 'Dubi' Pick: Amare Stoudemire:

“My all-time team of teammates: Steve Nash, Carmelo Anthony, Allen Iverson, Shaquille O'Neal - I would be power forward and Shag center - Dwyane Wade and LeBron James.”

Amare Stoudemire on LeBron James, Dwyane Wade, Carmelo Anthony, Shaquille O'Neal, Allen Iverson, Steve Nash, Aug 9, 2016. Source: Twitter @IAmDPick.

item.title: Josh Richardson on Shaquille O'Neal
item.description:
Heat rookieJosh Richardson received a new nickname from Shaquille O'Neal last night BRA (Baby Ray Allen).Josh Richardson on BRA:

“I can't really pay it too much mind. But I think it's cool somebody as influential as Shaquille O'Neal gave me a nickname.”

Josh Richardson on Shaquille O'Neal, Apr 6, 2016. Source: Twitter @Manny_Navarro.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Shaquille O'Neal
item.description:
“If we didn't butt heads, we wouldn't have won championships. There's different variations of healthy butting heads and not healthy. [Shaquille O'Neal] and I would butt heads in a very unhealthy way, but then we figured out how to make it happen.”

Kobe Bryant on Shaquille O'Neal, Apr 4, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Pat Riley on Shaquille O'Neal
item.description:
Jason Lieser:Pat Riley on Shaquille O'Neal:

“That decision was made a long time ago by the great Shaquille O'Neal. It was an absolute pleasure to have him here.”

Pat Riley on Shaquille O'Neal, Feb 9, 2016. Source: Twitter @JasonLieser.

item.title: Jalen Rose on Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan, Shaquille O'Neal
item.description:
ESPN analyst Jalen Rose said.

“Like the best player in the league usually is also physically opposing — 6-6 plus, scowl on his face, menacing. With the attitude that we appreciated because like a Michael Jordan or Shaquille O'Neal, or Kobe Bryant, you know, just a cutthroat nature. Steph allows us into his living room. We see him on a national stage be a son, a dad, a husband, a father, a brother. And he does all of it while continuing to improve.”

Jalen Rose on Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan, Shaquille O'Neal, Dec 26, 2015. Source: Associated Press.

item.title: Jabari Parker on Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan, Shaquille O'Neal, Allen Iverson, Tracy McGrady
item.description:
“I never watched Michael. I was too young to realize the game. Until I watched Michael Jordan to the Max (the IMAX documentary film). That was way after he retired. It's always been Kobe, it's been Allen Iverson. It's been Shaq (Shaquille O'Neal), Tracy McGrady. Those guys were my idols. He (Bryant) did the unimaginable. Especially after Shaq left, he exploded. Then he won those two championships without him.”

Jabari Parker on Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan, Shaquille O'Neal, Allen Iverson, Tracy McGrady, Dec 15, 2015. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Shaquille O'Neal, Dennis Rodman, Bill Russell
item.description:
“I’ve seen Shaq [Shaquille O’Neal] win titles, Bill Russell win titles, Dennis Rodman win titles. So there’s a lot of guys that have missed free throws and won a lot of NBA titles, so that’s not a concern for me at all. What D.J. does for our team is far more valuable than those missed free throws. “I can’t remember the last time he didn’t [have energy for us]. He plays with great spirit and plays hard pretty much every night and he does everything right for us. I agree with Jeff Van Gundy, he should just go walk out on the All-Star Game and go play. Just start playing. Nobody’s going to tell him to get off [the court]. So I think he should just go do it.”

Doc Rivers on Shaquille O'Neal, Dennis Rodman, Bill Russell, Feb 8, 2015. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Danny Green on Shaquille O'Neal
item.description:
“I did sing a couple of songs. … A little dancing. You had to greet (O'Neal and some other veterans) a certain way. It was all fun and games, but it's a lot different when you're (a) rookie that's playing than a rookie that's not playing. They had a little fun with me because I wasn't playing much.”

Danny Green on Shaquille O'Neal, Jun 16, 2013. Source: Sulia.

item.title: Dominique Wilkins on Shaquille O'Neal, World Championship
item.description:
Dominique Wilkins today reflected on his time with USA Basketball:

“That was a great time. Dream Team II was unbelievable. That was an unbelievable team and to be with a lot of those guys, who I call characters now, Shaquille was a character. That was an unbelievable team and that was a great time to be a part of USA Basketball, to stand on that podium, to receive those gold medals pretty much killing everybody. There was nobody even close to us in that World Championship series. It was fun.”

Dominique Wilkins on Shaquille O'Neal, World Championship, Feb 16, 2013. Source: Facebook.com.

item.title: Jerry West on Shaquille O'Neal
item.description:
“We were fortunately in the position to get ourselves in the Shaquille O'Neal derby. But a lot of things had to break right. And they did.”

Jerry West on Shaquille O'Neal, Jul 19, 2012. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Phil Jackson, Shaquille O'Neal
item.description:
Kobe Bryant on Phil Jackson and Shaquille O'Neal:

“All three of us were extremely stubborn. It was very very difficult for [Phil] to find that balance.”

Kobe Bryant on Phil Jackson, Shaquille O'Neal, Jul 16, 2012. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Dwight Howard on Shaquille O'Neal
item.description:
Josh Robbins:Dwight:

“He's mad about 'Superman.' I didn't know he made it up. I didn't know Superman came from Shaquille O'Neal.”

Dwight Howard on Shaquille O'Neal, Jan 20, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Jerry West on Kobe Bryant, Shaquille O'Neal, Magic Johnson
item.description:
“I think Shaquille put himself in a very precarious position with something he said in Hawaii and they moved on and Kobe Bryant was ready to take center stage. “To some degree it was almost like when [Kareem] Abdul-Jabbar and Magic Johnson were here. Abdul-Jabbar abdicated his throne for a player who was in the middle of his prime and I think Shaquille’s personality is completely different than Kobe’s personality and by making a tough decision they were able to win a couple more championships. Obviously here in Los Angeles they want you to win but they want you to win at the very highest level.”

Jerry West on Kobe Bryant, Shaquille O'Neal, Magic Johnson, Nov 3, 2011. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Shaquille O'Neal
item.description:
Ethan J. Skolnick:Wade on Shaq:

“He's a legend, he's a living legend. It's unfortunate, but nothing takes away from Shaquille O'Neal.”

Dwyane Wade on Shaquille O'Neal, May 11, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Mikhail Prokhorov on Shaquille O'Neal
item.description:
Of course, Prokhorov’s reaction to this was pure Prokhorov:

“While I have nothing but the greatest respect for Shaquille O’Neal, my purchase of a majority stake in the Nets was always predicated on the team moving to Brooklyn. We look forward to having the team in Newark while the Barclays Center arena is under construction, and are fully committed to New Jersey and to the fans there for the next two years. After that, we hope that fans from all over - New Jersey, New York, and beyond - will stick with a new Nets team that is young, strong, and hungry to win. “Regarding the gracious offer to become general manager, Shaq is always welcome to send his resume to Billy King.”

Mikhail Prokhorov on Shaquille O'Neal, Oct 7, 2010. Source: Bergen Record.
